set.body: Add typed per-family requests and explicit JVM interpreters: pinned FSL XML Harvard-Oxford/Julich, HCPex, Olsen MTL/hippocampal, and native upstream subcortical families (CIT168, HCP thalamus, MDTB10, HCP hippocampus/amygdala). User selected original upstream atlases in their native spaces with explicit provenance because named TemplateFlow harmonized assets were unavailable. Anatomical visual-cortex datasets remain in scope; rendering is excluded. Pin source asset specifications and expected digests; discovery describes executable requests honestly. Acceptance per family: offline parser fixtures, canonical identity/coverage/provenance, checked failures, JVM loading evidence and JS descriptor tests. Native MDTB10 currently requires upstream image4s INT8 support and an immutable pin update.
